android.desc:
Find anything inside your screenshots in seconds.
Stop scrolling endlessly through your gallery. ScreenFind lets you search and find text inside your screenshots instantly.
🔍 Search your screenshots Quickly find messages, notes, and important information saved in your screenshots.
💬 Find old messages Search text from chat screenshots and locate conversations in seconds.
💳 Find receipts & payments Locate bank transfers, IBAN numbers, transaction details, and payment confirmations easily.
📈 Track financial screenshots Search crypto, trading, and exchange screenshots without manually checking each image.
⚡ Fast and simple Type what you’re looking for and get results instantly.
🔒 Private & secure Everything stays on your device. Your data is not shared.
Perfect for: • WhatsApp and chat screenshots
• Bank receipts and IBAN search
• Crypto and trading screenshots
• Notes and saved information
Save time and find what you need — instantly.
